select * from om.om_tasks WHERE
SOURCE_CODE ='DEP' and COALESCE(BATCH_NO,1)='2' and DA
and



select fulldate
from 
    eds.eds_ctl ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.DEPOSITS_Date=dd.previous_business_day and dd.business_day_flag='Y'

alter table om.om_tasks add BATCH_NO INT

UPDATE OM.OM_TASKS
SET BATCH_NO=1
WHERE
SOURCE_CODE ='DEP' AND
TASK_NAME IN
(
	 'TSK_EDS_BRANCH_DIM'
